notes.title: From Drink Empire to Election Tycoon: Check Out Our New Game!
notes.content:
Loved building a drink empire from scratch? In Election Tycoon: Trump vs Harris, your strategic and management skills are put to the test once again—this time in the high-stakes world of U.S. politics! Lead campaigns, fund ads, and flip states to win. Explore the thrill of political strategy today! Please do not forget to try our demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170840/Election_Tycoon_Trump_vs_Harris/
